title: Water Filtration and DNA/RNA Extraction from Microbial Communities
author: Christopher A Hempel
materials: Bashing tubes can be stored at -20°C

steps.title: Sterilize Tools
steps.instruction: Sterilize forceps and scissors before each filtration using a burner, bleach, and EtOH.

steps.title: Filter Water Sample
steps.instruction: Filter the water sample while maintaining strict contamination control.

substeps.instruction: Keep the filtration unit closed when opening the wrapping.
Hold nothing but the sample over the unit.
Stand as far as possible away from the unit while it is open.

steps.title: Process Filter
steps.instruction: Cut the filter into small pieces using forceps and scissors while the filter remains on the filtration unit.

substeps.instruction: Stand as far as possible away from the unit during cutting.

steps.title: Transfer Filter Pieces
steps.instruction: Transfer the filter pieces into bashing tubes.

substeps.instruction: Ensure all pieces are covered with DNA/RNA Shield.

steps.title: Clean Equipment
steps.instruction: Clean the filtration unit adapter with bleach after each filtration.
